research.title: Impact of INT8 Quantization on Compact ECG-Based AF Detection on ESP32-S3
points: Research question: how INT8 quantization affects AF detection performance, memory usage and inference time of a compact 1D CNN on a microcontroller.
Pipeline: single-lead ECG dataset, preprocessing, Float32 baseline, post-training INT8 quantization, deployment with TensorFlow Lite Micro on ESP32-S3.
Evaluation: detection performance, memory, inference time, model size and compute requirements.
